title: A Day Trip to Tianjin: Skip the Tianjin Eye
titleZh: 天津一日游：别坐天津之眼
description: With Beijing's drone ban now in effect, Steven takes his drone to Tianjin and recaps the trip: the commute between the two cities and the cheaper rent, a Starbucks Reserve inside a 1921 bank, an Apple Store visit that killed his urge to upgrade, and a church guard who asked him to cross himself on the spot. He also explains why he and his girlfriend skipped the Porcelain House and the Tianjin Eye.

sentences.zh: 内容速览
sentences.en: Content Overview

sentences.zh: 今天这期节目，史蒂文聊的是天津。
sentences.en: In today's episode, Steven talks about Tianjin.

sentences.zh: 北京的无人机禁令生效前，他趁周末带着无人机去了一趟。
sentences.en: Before Beijing's drone ban took effect, he took his drone there for a trip over the weekend.

sentences.zh: 昨天的节目被“无人机风波”占满了，所以今天才是正式的旅行回顾：天津到北京的通勤、老银行里的星巴克、让他打消购物念头的苹果店、让他当场证明天主教徒身份的教堂门卫，还有因为一堆“不吉利”评价而被放弃的天津之眼。
sentences.en: Yesterday's episode was taken up entirely by the "drone saga," so today is the proper trip recap: the commute from Tianjin to Beijing, the Starbucks inside an old bank, the Apple Store that put him off shopping, the church doorman who made him prove on the spot that he's Catholic, and the Tianjin Eye, which he skipped because of a pile of "bad luck" reviews.

sentences.zh: 为什么是天津，为什么是现在
sentences.en: Why Tianjin, and why now

sentences.zh: 从上周末起，在北京拥有无人机或其零件已属违法。
sentences.en: As of last weekend, owning a drone or its parts in Beijing is illegal.

sentences.zh: 史蒂文的无人机没法寄走，只好亲自带到天津。
sentences.en: Steven couldn't ship his drone, so he had to bring it to Tianjin himself.

sentences.zh: 天津对他来说是老朋友。
sentences.en: For him, Tianjin is an old friend.

sentences.zh: 从北京南站坐高铁，大约半小时。
sentences.en: It's about half an hour by high-speed train from Beijing South Station.

sentences.zh: 这座城市约有1400万人口，2015年的爆炸事故曾让它登上世界新闻。
sentences.en: The city has a population of about 14 million, and the 2015 explosion once put it in the world news.

sentences.zh: 史蒂文住在五大道附近的亚朵酒店，那一带有两百多座百年老建筑，西式味儿十足。
sentences.en: Steven is staying at the Atour Hotel near the Five Great Avenues, an area with over two hundred century-old buildings and a strong Western feel.

sentences.zh: 用他的话说：“想逛城市的话，天津算一个吧。”
sentences.en: In his words: "If you want to explore a city, Tianjin is one worth considering."

sentences.zh: 房租便宜，列车爆满
sentences.en: Cheap rent, packed trains

sentences.zh: 别指望在天津放松。
sentences.en: Don't expect to relax in Tianjin.

sentences.zh: 这里人多，你会被人盯着看，交通也是大城市的样子，只是没北京那么糟。
sentences.en: It's crowded here, people will stare at you, and the traffic is what you'd expect in a big city, just not as bad as Beijing.

sentences.zh: 天津真正的吸引力是价格。
sentences.en: Tianjin's real appeal is the price.

sentences.zh: 北京6000元的房子，在天津可能只要3000到4000元。
sentences.en: A place that costs 6,000 yuan in Beijing might only cost 3,000 to 4,000 yuan in Tianjin.

sentences.zh: 所以高铁每五到十分钟一趟，照样一票难求，周日晚上和周一早上进京的车次尤其如此。
sentences.en: So even with a high-speed train every five to ten minutes, tickets are still hard to get, especially for trains into Beijing on Sunday evenings and Monday mornings.

sentences.zh: 很多人在天津还房贷，工作日在北京租一间1000到1500元的房间，算下来比直接在北京租房还划算。
sentences.en: Many people pay off a mortgage in Tianjin and rent a 1,000 to 1,500 yuan room in Beijing on weekdays, which works out cheaper than just renting in Beijing.

sentences.zh: 史蒂文会这么做吗？
sentences.en: Would Steven do this?

sentences.zh: 不会。
sentences.en: No.

sentences.zh: 订票、安检、赶车，这一套麻烦事，能躲就躲。
sentences.en: Booking tickets, security checks, rushing for trains: he avoids that whole hassle whenever he can.

sentences.zh: 给游客和外国居民
sentences.en: For tourists and foreign residents

sentences.zh: 多数游客只走北京、西安、上海“三件套”，跳过天津。
sentences.en: Most tourists only do the Beijing–Xi'an–Shanghai "big three" and skip Tianjin.

sentences.zh: 可要是你在北京待一周，天津就是一个轻松又便宜的一日游目的地，一个下午就能看完主要景点。
sentences.en: But if you're staying in Beijing for a week, Tianjin makes an easy, cheap day trip, and you can see the main sights in a single afternoon.

sentences.zh: 他们的酒店工作日大约300元，含自助早餐，周六约500元。
sentences.en: Their hotel was about 300 yuan on weekdays, buffet breakfast included, and about 500 yuan on Saturday.

sentences.zh: 他还见了一位认识了20年的朋友，对方刚从韩国釜山搬来，住在价格超低的郊区。
sentences.en: He also met up with a friend he's known for 20 years, who had just moved from Busan, South Korea, and lives in a super-cheap suburb.

sentences.zh: 和上海周边的城市一样，天津让你够得着北京，却不用付那份高房价。
sentences.en: Like the cities around Shanghai, Tianjin keeps Beijing within reach without making you pay Beijing's high rents.

sentences.zh: 酒店小记：日式马桶似乎是标配，但浴室门是玻璃的，“放点音乐也许是个好主意”。
sentences.en: Hotel notes: Japanese-style toilets seem to be standard, but the bathroom door is glass, so "playing some music might be a good idea."

sentences.zh: 当天雾霾很重，他要空气净化器，对方先递来一台香薰机，“根本是两码事”。
sentences.en: The smog was heavy that day, and when he asked for an air purifier, the staff first handed him an aroma diffuser: "Completely different things."

sentences.zh: 和平路与星巴克臻选
sentences.en: Heping Road and Starbucks Reserve

sentences.zh: 他们骑车去了和平路，这是天津一条很长的商业街，有点像王府井，其中一家“巧克力博物馆”，巧克力看着可疑地像纸做的。
sentences.en: They rode their bikes to Heping Road, a long shopping street in Tianjin, a bit like Wangfujing. One shop there was a "chocolate museum", and the chocolate looked suspiciously like it was made of paper.

sentences.zh: 街的一头是星巴克臻选河畔66旗舰店，位于一座1921年的银行大楼里。
sentences.en: At one end of the street is the Starbucks Reserve Riverside 66 flagship store, set in a bank building from 1921.

sentences.zh: 希腊风格的外立面、玻璃穹顶、大理石柱和百年银行柜台都原样保留。
sentences.en: The Greek-style facade, the glass dome, the marble columns and the century-old bank counters have all been kept as they were.

sentences.zh: 网红们摆着姿势拍甜点，史蒂文也在拍视频，不过他说自己“无论怎么看都算不上网红”。
sentences.en: Influencers were posing and taking photos of desserts, and Steven was filming a video too, though he said he was "not an influencer by any stretch".

sentences.zh: 手冲特调加一份麻薯芝士蛋糕，花了七十来块，两人不禁琢磨：为什么不在家煮更好的咖啡呢？
sentences.en: A special pour-over coffee plus a mochi cheesecake cost them about seventy yuan, and the two couldn't help wondering: why not just make better coffee at home?

sentences.zh: 好处是：洗手间很干净。
sentences.en: The upside: the restrooms were very clean.

sentences.zh: 苹果店与折叠屏iPhone Duo
sentences.en: The Apple Store and the foldable iPhone Duo

sentences.zh: 隔壁就是苹果店。
sentences.en: Right next door is an Apple Store.

sentences.zh: 他的iPhone 14 Pro Max拍了约90%的《语言博客》，升级到18代提升不够大。
sentences.en: His iPhone 14 Pro Max shot about 90% of "Language Blog," and upgrading to the 18th generation wouldn't be a big enough improvement.

sentences.zh: 正如他所说：“问题不在手机，在于用的人。”
sentences.en: As he put it: "The problem isn't the phone, it's the person using it."

sentences.zh: 折叠屏iPhone Duo被女朋友否决了，因为单手够不到另一边。
sentences.en: His girlfriend vetoed the foldable iPhone Duo because you can't reach the other side with one hand.

sentences.zh: 它还是第一代产品，价格又高。
sentences.en: It's still a first-generation product, and it's expensive too.

sentences.zh: 触屏MacBook更让他心动：用手指操作Logic，比用键盘快捷键还快。
sentences.en: A touchscreen MacBook tempts him more: operating Logic with his fingers would be even faster than keyboard shortcuts.

sentences.zh: 可他现在这台MacBook还没还完款。
sentences.en: But he still hasn't finished paying off the MacBook he has now.

sentences.zh: 这趟逛店，其实是为了“把分期付款的念头清出脑子”。
sentences.en: This store visit was really about "clearing the idea of installment payments out of his head."

sentences.zh: 天津西开教堂
sentences.en: St. Joseph's Cathedral (Xikai Church), Tianjin

sentences.zh: 和平路的另一头是西开教堂，一座仍在使用的罗马天主教堂。
sentences.en: At the other end of Heping Road is Xikai Church, a Roman Catholic church that is still in use.

sentences.zh: 周日不对游客开放。
sentences.en: It isn't open to tourists on Sundays.

sentences.zh: 门口的人问他是不是天主教徒，他说是，对方就让他画十字来证明。
sentences.en: The person at the door asked him if he was Catholic; he said yes, so they had him make the sign of the cross to prove it.

sentences.zh: 他从小是乌克兰天主教徒，也记不清哪种传统先碰哪边肩膀。
sentences.en: He was raised Ukrainian Catholic, and he couldn't remember which tradition touches which shoulder first.

sentences.zh: 最后，他们没有进去。
sentences.en: In the end, they didn't go in.

sentences.zh: 瓷房子，和没去的“眼”
sentences.en: The Porcelain House, and the "Eye" they skipped

sentences.zh: 五大道的中国瓷房子，是一座1920年代的法式小楼，贴满了数以亿计的瓷片。
sentences.en: The China House on Five Great Avenues is a 1920s French-style building covered in hundreds of millions of porcelain shards.

sentences.zh: 门票50元，小红书上都说是“坑”，所以他们放弃了。
sentences.en: Tickets cost 50 yuan, and everyone on Xiaohongshu called it a "rip-off," so they gave it a miss.

sentences.zh: 他转而拍《语言博客》，大声说英语，再举着手机，立刻招来一群人围观拍照。
sentences.en: Instead, he filmed for "Language Blog," speaking English loudly while holding up his phone, and a crowd immediately gathered to watch and take photos.

sentences.zh: 拍了三遍，他总算拍到暮色中亮灯的瓷房子。
sentences.en: After three takes, he finally got a shot of the Porcelain House lit up at dusk.

sentences.zh: 至于天津之眼，女朋友翻到两位女生的评价：坐完摩天轮就分手了。
sentences.en: As for the Tianjin Eye, his girlfriend came across a review by two young women: they broke up right after riding the Ferris wheel.

sentences.zh: “算了”，他们不去了。
sentences.en: "Forget it," they decided, and didn't go.

sentences.zh: 包子、菠萝包和粉色单车
sentences.en: Baozi, pineapple buns and pink bikes

sentences.zh: 天津的招牌美食有煎饼果子和狗不理包子，大意是“狗都不理”。
sentences.en: Tianjin's signature foods include jianbing guozi and Goubuli baozi, a name that roughly means "even dogs ignore it."

sentences.zh: 他们改买了麻花和港式菠萝包。
sentences.en: They bought mahua and Hong Kong-style pineapple buns instead.

sentences.zh: 菠萝包里没有菠萝，只是一层带交叉纹路的酥皮，里面夹黄油或奶油。
sentences.en: There's no pineapple in a pineapple bun. It's just a layer of crisp crust with a criss-cross pattern, filled with butter or cream.

sentences.zh: 总共花了48元。
sentences.en: It cost 48 yuan in total.

sentences.zh: 他点了抹茶，喝了一口才想起自己不爱抹茶，只好硬着头皮喝完。
sentences.en: He ordered a matcha, and only after one sip did he remember he doesn't like matcha, so he had to force himself to finish it.

sentences.zh: 他们骑支付宝的粉色单车去车站。
sentences.en: They rode Alipay's pink bikes to the station.

sentences.zh: 搬运无人机花了他约1200元，而政府本来愿意出3000元收购。
sentences.en: Moving the drone cost him about 1,200 yuan, while the government had originally been willing to pay 3,000 yuan to buy it.

sentences.zh: 现在无人机躺在上海，怎么处理他还没想好。
sentences.en: Now the drone is sitting in Shanghai, and he still hasn't decided what to do with it.

sentences.zh: 今日总结
sentences.en: Today's Summary

sentences.zh: 天津便宜、离得近，还很漂亮，非常值得从北京来一趟一日游。
sentences.en: Tianjin is cheap, close by, and really pretty, so it's well worth a day trip from Beijing.

sentences.zh: 不过，要是你珍惜感情，天津之眼还是别去了。
sentences.en: But if you value your relationship, you'd better skip the Tianjin Eye.

vocab.en: tickets are hard to get; sold out
